metadata.description: Vendor-neutral cloud architecture design for Claude Code.

plugins.name: cloud-architect
plugins.description: Vendor-neutral cloud architecture sized to what your team can actually run: new systems, features that fit your existing codebase, and migrations with cut-over and rollback. Options with rough cost, portability, data residency, diagrams, ADRs with fitness criteria and a CTO decision brief. Architecture only; reads code, never writes it.
